spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
headerEntries: Eliphas casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (save {@dc 15}):

entries: Eliphas is a gentleman and a tinkerer. For years, he offered his services to the Golden Vault, an organization dedicated to preserving historical relics and keeping powerful items out of evil hands. Eliphas designed the magical music boxes that the Golden Vault uses to communicate with its field operatives.
Eliphas is a neutral good, human werebear who can adopt the form of a polar bear.
